content: Khazing kha a pei my lo
Naa hrong letah a dai le a hrychae khah ze tamaw a chuasah? Naa chung letei a dy teipaw he naa dunah thinglung taitah va chuh bei maw?

Hming sangkheh kheh naa du, canghrasala naa dupaw hming cawh hmuh khy bei ceh. Du tu he ceh ka, lee naa nong, canghrasala naa dupaw hming cawh hmuh khy hlui bei ceh. A hrychae he ceh ka, na dai he ceh. Hmuh hlui bei ceh, zecawtamaw tatah Khazing kha naa hae lynah cawtah a cang.
Naa hae tihtah hmuh hlui bei ceh, zecawtamaw tatah naa hmuhpaw khah a nawngsenah letah kaa hmang a tahpaw ahmang lypaw rawhnah khatah naa haenah cawtah a cang.

Naaning a phei a hmangpaw cawngsaw sahlo, khazaw khatei a huikongnah cawh Khazing a huapaw a cang tahpaw hnih thlang bei he ceh maw? Khazaw khatei a huikongnah a thingpaw cawngsaw cawh Khazing a carae a cang kho.
A cang ly leh kaa chung letei a chiapaw Thlawpaw cawh hnachua a thaipaw a cang tahpaw Capathai bia heh silang a hnui lypaw a cang tatah maw naa rawh?
Canghrasala Khazing taco ningdonah alai vypaw a ma peh. Macawtaco Capathai letah:

content.text: “Khazing taco a palai a patuipaw khah dy he ka,
a panypaw khah ning a do he,”

content: a tahpaw khah a cang.
Macawtaco Khazing letah a pei my lo. Setan khah dy la, a ca saisai he a.
Khazing cawh a va ne la, a ca ne hra he a. Naaning mehsua sahlo, naa kih a si my lo, naaning lungreh a hnui lypaw sahlo, naa lungthing khah pathaisah my lo.
Ngechia tah ung la, cá la, saang tua o. Naa hnuinahpaw khah cawnah tah thlai la, naa lunglawngnah khah ngechianah tah thlai my lo.
Abuipaw hme letah a pany la, Ama taco a ca cuicaling he a.

Uny sahlo, pakheh le pakheh naa kongchia a rei khe o. A uny a reipachiapaw, a cang ly leh bia a ce pahpaw cawngsaw taco phungbia khah a reipachia a cang ly leh bia a cetupaw a cang. Phungbia khah bia na cepah tihtah nama cawh phungbia a zuipaw cang bei ceh, bia a cepah tu na cang hri.
Phungbia a peitu le biacetu cawh pakheh suitei a cang, Ama cawh a pachah khypaw le a rawhrang khypaw khah a cang, canghrasala naa ingpaw bia a ce pahpaw khah ahomaw naa cang?
Ningthlamong kong letah a pachawnah

Naaning, “Atoning a cang ly leh ningthlamong cawh ma khuapui lang kheh, a cang ly leh ma khuapui lang heh kung kheh ung tah sei neh ka, cho va hrawng neh ka, tangka ka va hui taw a,” a tahpaw sahlo nge tua o.

Ningthlamong letah zemaw a tlung a tahmai naa hni ly pawtah zecawtamaw ma hraco naa tah? Naa hringnah heh zemaw a lo a tah naa hni maw? Naaning cawh sung sungkheh tah ka tho katei, a ly kaw thahpaw meding hapaw na cang he ceh kho.
Ma navy co, “Abuipaw tah a rai a tah caco, ma hraco ung he peh ka, ma heh a cang ly leh ma kheh kaa tua a,” naa tah hri be!
Canghrasala, a palai a patui he ceh ka, na pachaw na palaw he ceh; a pachaw a palawnah vytei heh suanah a cang hi.
Mataico tua ruapaw hming chawpaw hni thlang tlung tei, a tua lypaw cawh a cawtah sua a cang.
